title: Resumed X activity and amplification recovery
scope: Twelve recovered event or post records, not an exhaustive native-platform export.

coverage.count_basis: Addition of the source's annual X counts, not independently deduplicated acquisition of those 611 records.
coverage.note: The overall site updates through September 2026, but that does not establish equally current X acquisition. Do not add 611 to the earlier corpus count without record-level acquisition and deduplication.

defaults.source_access: Public archive or contemporaneous report. Native X body was not successfully retrieved.
defaults.attribution_rule: An RT marker identifies a quoted or reshared speaker in the witness. It does not by itself supply the original post ID or the exact time of Trump's separate resharing action.
defaults.date_rule: For SuperTrumpTracker post pages, retain the displayed calendar date and time without assigning a timezone: the general listing displays Europe/Rome while its calendar says Eastern. Reporting dates and verified Eastern dates are labeled separately.

records.date_basis: Contemporaneous US reporting and the archive's Eastern-date statistics page.
records.upstream_author: Fulton County Sheriff's Office booking photograph; graphic assembly not established here.
records.description: The account's return post combines the booking photograph with defiance language and a campaign link.
records.research_use: A custody photograph is recast as a public identity and loyalty message. This records the account's publication, not a judgment about the pending charges or a supernatural event.
records.review_task: Preserve the exact graphic and compare it with later uses; do not confuse reinstatement in 2022 with first subsequent publication.

records.upstream_author: Campaign production; individual editor not established.
records.description: A campaign video marks renewed posting ahead of the Musk interview.
records.research_use: A return-to-platform marker and a media-review lead, not a full transcription of the campaign video.
records.review_task: Recover the canonical native post ID and distinguish a published timeline post from separately delivered campaign ads.

records.date_basis: The archive statistics page displays June 21, 7:53 PM Eastern.
records.description: The retrieved text witness contains a short link, not a readable transcription of the linked content.
records.research_use: An example of why link-only posts must not be discarded by the text filter. No military content is inferred from its date alone.
records.review_task: Recover the linked artifact before attaching a thematic classification.

records.description: Trump tells the addressed aviation and other audiences to regard Venezuelan airspace as closed.
records.research_use: Relevant to asserted authority over cross-border movement. The announcement is distinct from aviation notices, legal authority and actual enforcement.
records.review_task: Attach independently sourced implementation records and preserve the exact target and territorial scope.

records.research_use: Coverage control; no prophetic relevance assigned.
records.review_task: Preserve media attribution before classifying the artifact.

records.description: Weather-preparedness text followed by a National Weather Service share marker.
records.research_use: A mixed-authorship record: Trump's added comment is not interchangeable with the linked agency's words. No apocalyptic interpretation assigned.
records.review_task: Recover the quoted agency post and native relationship type.

records.upstream_author: Regine Mahaux, photo credit in the post
records.description: Film promotion with an explicit photographer credit.
records.research_use: A control showing that an image published by the account need not be authored by Trump.
records.review_task: Keep photographer credit separate from caption authorship.

records.description: An approving comment about a second viewing of the film.
records.research_use: Coverage control; no prophetic relevance assigned.
records.review_task: Resolve the source display timezone before a minute-level chronology.

records.description: The archive marks this film-promotion item as a repost of Melania Trump's account.
records.research_use: Reposted wording remains attributed to its upstream speaker, while distribution is retained as an account event.
records.review_task: Recover native original and repost-wrapper identifiers.

records.description: A repost-marked Hollywood Reporter box-office item.
records.research_use: A retained amplification event, not a new Trump-authored box-office analysis or prophetic correspondence.
records.review_task: Recover the upstream article and native share relationship.

records.description: A repost-marked Fox News item about the documentary's opening.
records.research_use: Demonstrates explicit retention of another account's message without treating its factual claims as independently verified.

records.description: A repost-marked wedding thank-you video from Dan Scavino.
records.research_use: The latest X entry found in this source. Its routine subject is retained as coverage evidence, not assigned a theological conclusion.
records.review_task: Determine whether later X posts are absent from the archive or absent from the account; this record alone cannot decide.
